description: List or fetch workflow executions. Omit identity args to list (optional workflowId, limit, offset, pendingApprovalOnly, assignedToMeOnly). Pass workflowExecutionId for one execution (includeActions defaults true). Pass workflowId + latestOnly=true for the last run on an optional branch / userId (since-last-run scoping).

assignedToMeOnly.description: Only executions assigned to the calling user (OAuth user, or the bot's owner with --bot).

name: get-workflow-executions
title: Get Workflow Executions
